label: components
quotes: Bullets
Bullets is a UI component module rendering bullet point visual elements, with no further behavioral detail available from current declarations.
Button
The Button module defines the Button atom component, a basic clickable UI building block exported for use throughout the design system.
Count
The Count module defines a single Count component with no recorded requirements.
Image
Image is a UI component responsible for rendering image content within the application.
Logo
Logo is a UI component module rendering the application's brand logo graphic.
MenuItem
The module defines a single MenuItem component representing a selectable entry within a menu UI.
SocialIcon
A simple presentational component that renders a clickable social media icon linking out to an external profile or page.
Text
Documented the Text module as a minimal UI component responsible for rendering styled text.
LiveThemeToggle
LiveThemeToggle is a UI control component that lets a user switch the active visual theme at runtime.
ThemeToggle
The Theme toggle module provides a UI control for switching the application's color theme.
Card
Card is a UI component module providing a reusable card presentational element, though no further details or requirements have been recorded yet.
Carousel
Carousel is a React component module providing a sliding/scrolling track UI, exporting a Carousel component for use elsewhere in the design system.
